title: Senior Business Analyst - Latin America, Remote
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior Business Analyst - Latin America, Remote em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community. We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve. You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated. Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points. Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases. Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence. Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution. Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira. Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint. Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts. Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made. Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage. Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients. Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later. Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts. Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions. Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction. Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs. 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects. Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment. Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements. Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules). Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs. Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders. Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints. Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients. Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech). Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms. Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS. Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects. Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases. Generous paid-time-off policy Flexible working hours Work remotely Continuing education, training, conferences Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business. You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry! #J-18808-Ljbffr

Principais Responsabilidades: Gerenciar as contas de clientes designadas e manter relacionamentos sólidos no dia a dia. Oferecer um alto nível de atendimento ao cliente e contribuir para a satisfação geral dos clientes. Identificar oportunidades para ampliar os negócios dentro das contas existentes. Trabalhar em parceria com equipes internas para apoiar a prestação de serviços e atender às necessidades dos clientes. Identificar, comunicar e ajudar a resolver problemas relacionados aos serviços de forma ágil. Manter informações de clientes, atividades das contas e ações de acompanhamento atualizadas e precisas. Monitorar as atividades das contas e dar suporte a relatórios ou ao acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), quando aplicável. Experiência em gestão de contas, atendimento ao cliente, desenvolvimento de negócios, logística nacional e internacional, cadeia de suprimentos (Supply Chain) ou áreas correlatas. Fortes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente e construção de relacionamentos. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita. Capacidade de documentar e comunicar claramente os requisitos dos clientes. Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e habilidade para coordenar a solução de questões entre diferentes equipes. Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades e garantir acompanhamento consistente das demandas. Proficiência no pacote Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint e Power BI) e em sistemas de negócios ou ferramentas de CRM. Atenção aos detalhes e fortes habilidades organizacionais. Experiência no suporte a contas de clientes complexas, envolvendo múltiplos stakeholders e/ou diferentes localidades. Habilidade para conduzir apresentações. Conhecimentos e habilidades em gestão de projetos. Experiência na identificação de oportunidades de crescimento e expansão de negócios em contas existentes. Experiência em ambientes de serviços com atuação multifuncional (cross-functional), colaborando com diferentes áreas da organização. Inglês intermediário a avançado. Graduação em Administração, Logística, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
